sophia.r: hey team, day 1 question — need Vault read access + an optional KMS wrap for a short demo with an external sandbox. who should I ping and what exactly goes in the request?

kevin.l: welcome! :wave: best is to use @secrets-bot. Minimal fields: env, resource, reason, duration_hours. Add wrap_key and target_account if sharing outside.

maria.s: also include `access=read|write` (default read). For demos pick `read` and short duration (2-4h). If you select wrap, security will run cross-account checks and may ask for extra justification.

sophia.r: can someone paste a copy/paste template?

secrets-bot: Template: `@secrets-bot request env=staging resource=secret/data/team/<team>/<name> access=read reason="<short reason>" duration_hours=3 wrap_key=projects/<proj>/.../cryptoKeys/<key> target_account=acct-XXXXX audit_label=<label>` Example: `@secrets-bot request env=staging resource=secret/data/team/redwood-inference/demo access=read reason="onboard demo" duration_hours=3 audit_label=onboard-sophia`

kevin.l: note: add `sensitivity=high` for any PII/payment data; that'll trigger extra notifications and tighter auditing.

sophia.r: ok sending now. `@secrets-bot request env=staging resource=secret/data/team/redwood-inference/demo access=read reason="partner sandbox demo" duration_hours=3 audit_label=onboard-sophia`

secrets-bot: Request received. Ticket SEC-6222 created. Infra will review; allow ~30m. For wrap requests include `wrap_key` and `target_account`; that can add cloud-security review time.

maria.s: once approved you'll authenticate via SSO OIDC and run `vault login -method=oidc role=redwood-dev` then `vault kv get -field=value secret/team/redwood-inference/demo`. Dont save decrypted files and add the SEC ticket to any PR that references the secret.

infra-oncall: SEC-6222 approved for 3h read-only. Token posted to the ticket. Reminder: production or cross-account wraps need two approvers and a revocation runbook.

sophia.r: got it, can fetch secret. thanks everyone! one more Q: if the demo becomes persistent later, what's the recommended migration path?

maria.s: migrate to a service-role, enable auto-rotation, and assign owners. File a new request for service-role and attach a migration_plan.md + revocation_runbook.md. We'll require product/infra approval for prod.

sophia.r: perfect, appreciate the fast help. closing this thread once I update the demo PR with SEC-6222. :thumbsup:
